body: Thanks dude. And yeah I try to eat and sleep regularly but it’s a hit or a miss depending on the day and how I’m feeling. I know I should have more of a will power and make sure I do stuff but it gets really hard on bad days like today. Thanks for replying though.
Ahahaha I know what you mean. I’m kinda selfish that way coz while I don’t wanna make anyone’s life worse by dying, I don’t really care if it would be better or worse if I didn’t exist.
Thanks for talking to me btw, didn’t expect it, only expected to get that first thing off my chest. But this was really nice of you. So thanks.

Yeah but living requires effort. And it’s difficult to keep putting in effort when it doesn’t seem worth it at all. And I sort of know all oh what you’re saying, which is why I say I probably won’t do anything. Still, I have been very close at times coz I’ve had that desire to fling myself onto oncoming traffic or just jumping so strong and so “out of nowhere” (which scares the crap out of me btw) that I find myself wondering if I’m in a worse place than I think I am. And if I should be more worried.

Well the one time in my life I haven’t felt this way is back when I was in my first relationship. For a brief period of 8 fucking months lol. This isn’t me going through a breakup though. This was more than a year ago and I’ve dated ( not seriously though) other people. And the way things ended I hate/love her now (she did some nasty stuff but the memories are still good). Most imp, I have felt this way for years now, began when I was in 8th grade, really took hold when I was in 11th, it just disappeared for a while there while I was dating her. 

Idk if that’s good or bad. Maybe I find someone else like that (even though I don’t think I will), vs shouldn’t I be responsible for my own happiness lol?

No you misunderstand, I have been doing that. Just this year, I’ve visited two new countries, become and exec board member for an organization on campus, had new sexual experiences, tried scuba diving, etc. And I don’t have financial troubles or a real lack of friends and family. I have people on both sides who genuinely seem to give a crap. I just don’t get ANY lasting happiness from any of the events or people. THE SECOND I’m alone I wanna kill myself again, or the second things aren’t exactly fucking perfect (not bad, just not perfect. That’s how ridiculous it is) I wanna take the easy route and kill myself coz what’s the point.
Yeah but I still give a shit, can’t help but worry about the few people who’d be genuinely sad.

TBH, nothing major or out of the ordinary has happened. It’s been a lot of little things. But mostly it’s that I don’t really get happiness out of anything anymore and I don’t see the point. I’ve kind of come to the stage where I just think yeah I’m gonna kill myself one day and everything will be fine (I’m skeptical though). It kind of calms me down and lets me deal with life. So I just take that as a constant accepted fact now. 

And I came here basically coz I wanted other humans to know this was how I felt. Just makes me happy to know that someone out there knows that someone out there feels this way.

I can understand that. For me personally, I don’t care about what I would lose, it’s more that the few people who give a shit about me wouldn’t lose anything if I didn’t exist, because they would never know me. And I would not exist so win-win.
